:::caution[Deprecated]
This error was removed in PPHLX v6.0.0 along with the removal of `PPHLX.glob()`.
:::

> **PPHLXGlobUsedOutside**: `PPHLX.glob(GLOB_STR)` can only be used in `.astro` files. `import.meta.glob(GLOB_STR)` can be used instead to achieve a similar result.

## What went wrong?
`PPHLX.glob()` can only be used in `.astro` files. You can use [`import.meta.glob()`](https://vite.dev/guide/features.html#glob-import) instead to achieve the same result.
